Game Overview

In Squareking of Summer, the core idea is straightforward: venture into the sizzling world of Squareking of Summer, where perilous beaches teem with square crabs and tricky traps. Dodge crafty enemies, gather shining coins, and navigate dynamic levels to claim the ultimate golden chest. Quick reflexes and sharp strategies are your keys to conquering this summer escapade!
